# `DelegatedHeaderProviderInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\Mcp\OpenApi\DelegatedHeaderProviderInterface`

**Interface** — [`Rasuvaeff\Mcp\OpenApi`](/packages/mcp-openapi) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/mcp-openapi/blob/master/src/DelegatedHeaderProviderInterface.php)

Exchanges an application identity for upstream headers on every bridged
operation call. Implementations must not forward the inbound MCP
Authorization/shared-secret header verbatim.

## Methods

### headers()

```php
headers(
    string $operationId,
    string $method,
    string $path,
    Identity\ExecutionIdentity $identity,
): array
```
